g.text: Every card on the site, at 1× web size, drawn by the live code. Use these as the starting point for new templates.
Fonts: Jazmin Alt Bold (display), GT America Light (reading), GT America Black (labels). Brief: README.md in this folder.
The default tag: classic shape, quote layout, accent band, coins. Shown at 1.6×.
